clue.text: Stiff examination

explanation.definitionFit: A necroscopy is a post-mortem, the formal inspection of a dead body to find the cause of death.

explanation.definitionFit: An imbecile is a stupid person, a common insult synonymous with a fool or idiot.

clue.text: Worn-out small honey bears stop!
